findings.detail: Three current-period one-stop positions are non-accrual; their principal, amortized cost, and fair value tie to the schedule's non-accrual one-stop totals.

rationale: Raw source confirms the non-accrual flag. Table 122 row 9 reports current-period one-stop non-accrual totals of principal 17,507, amortized cost 14,061, and fair value 9,682. The three localized SOI rows tie to those totals: Inhance Parent 5,325/2,133/2,503, Pluralsight 2,085/2,032/1,626, and RW AM Holdco 10,097/9,896/5,553. Because the source confirms three non-accrual positions rather than disproving the check, this is a real source-backed extraction/classification gap.
